_comment: One knowledge item per line, written into the produced skill as references/provenance.jsonl. Delete this comment line. Every item in the skill body should have a row here; a rule with no row is a rule nobody can re-check, and in six months it will be obeyed or overridden for the wrong reasons.

_schema.claim: one sentence, the rule as encoded
_schema.where: path inside the skill that carries it
_schema.evidence: [{class: Enforced|Repaired|Reasoned|Recent|Confirmed, pointer: rule name / sha / ADR / person}]
_schema.confirmed_by: name, when an evidence class is Confirmed
_schema.note: free text, e.g. what would retire this rule

claim: Handlers return Result<T, AppError>; nothing throws across a module boundary.
note: Retire if the lint rule is removed.

claim: Repos take a Tx as first argument and never open their own transaction.
note: Reverted once under load (double-commit on retry); tripwire in SKILL.md#dont.

claim: zod schemas live beside the handler, never in a shared schemas/ directory.
note: No enforcement; drifts if nobody watches.
